title: Kiosk event
description: One message the operator pushes on the event stream at <endpoint>/events. The root is CLOSED: an event carries the five members declared here and no others. `data` is typed by the topic's own `payload_schema`, published in the catalog's `events` array, and this schema deliberately does not constrain it -- the shape is the operator's to declare, per topic.

id.description: A PER-ORIGIN monotonic integer -- not per topic and not per subscriber. One integer therefore resumes every subscription a socket holds, and a subscriber compares integers instead of keeping a cursor per topic. A subscriber MUST ignore an id it has already seen: delivery is at-least-once.

topic.description: The topic this event belongs to, as declared in the catalog.

subject.description: What the event is ABOUT within the topic -- an order id, a list id. Null for a topic that has no subject. A subject-scoped subscription sees only its own.

occurred_at.description: When the operator's state actually changed, RFC 3339 in UTC. Not when the message was delivered: a replayed event carries the time of the transition, which is what a subscriber reasons about.

data.description: The payload, validating against the topic's payload_schema.
